summary.text: Greg Abbott is the Republican Governor of Texas, first elected in 2014 and re-elected in 2018 and 2022. He previously served as Texas Attorney General (2002–2015) and as a justice of the Texas Supreme Court (1996–2001). As governor he signed the state's education savings account (school choice) law, permitless handgun carry, and a 2025 law restricting abortion-inducing drugs.

paragraphs.text: Born in Wichita Falls, Texas; holds a business degree from the University of Texas at Austin and a law degree from Vanderbilt University.
Appointed to the Texas Supreme Court in 1996 and served until 2001; elected Attorney General in 2002 and served until 2015.
Chaired the Republican Governors Association from November 2019 to December 2020.
